provenance.gatheredBy: load-sport-data, the 2026 WNBA semifinals and Finals as played: Atlanta swept New York and Golden State swept Las Vegas in the best-of-five semifinals (4-9 October), and Golden State beat Atlanta 4-3 in the Finals (17-31 October). The semifinals are one event, game N holding both series' Game N; the Finals are one event of seven games. The field is every player in the round's ESPN box scores, injured players included, with ESPN's position (G, F or C) and birth country (Jonquel Jones's Bahamas as BS). ESPN gives no birthplace for eight players, so theirs is from Wikipedia: Pauline Astier, Marine Fauthoux and Janelle Salaün France, Raquel Carrera Spain, Sika Koné Mali, Matilde Villa Italy, Justė Jocytė the US (born in Washington, D.C.; she plays for Lithuania), and Aminata Gueye France (Wikipedia gives her nationality, not her birthplace). Ranking is the player's 2026 regular-season Triple Threat total (points + rebounds + assists) with her playoff team, from Basketball-Reference's team totals (Matilde Villa, who played no regular-season game for Atlanta, has none and ranks last); ties go by name. Each game's box score (points, rebounds, assists) is from ESPN, cross-checked player by player against Basketball-Reference, which agree on every line. A player who did not play a game has no line; one who played and scored no point, rebound or assist has an empty line.
